B.name: preserve-structured-multivalue-input
B.invariant: Repeated serialized inputs must be collected with their multiplicity intact, then validated into the declared sequence/tuple shape without changing scalar semantics.

C.name: ensure-cleanup-on-all-exit-paths
C.invariant: Owned multipart/file resources must be closed on normal completion, validation failure, endpoint failure, and other request exit paths.

D.name: exact-match-before-normalization
D.invariant: An explicit identifier or alias is already canonical user intent; normalization applies only to implicit/default names and must not expand the accepted identifier set.

E.name: align-reuse-with-lifetime-scope
E.invariant: Dependency cache identity must include lifetime scope so values with different cleanup boundaries are never incorrectly shared.

H.name: keep-payload-and-metadata-consistent
H.invariant: Intermediate response metadata must not describe an empty/stale payload when it is later merged into the final response; dependent metadata must be removed or recomputed.
